body:
Approved in principle and correctly sequenced, but deferred.

Keep cand-6XWW unchanged. After that exact B0R successor is reconciled and actually lands, propose a separate P2 status-only bead. Its truthful sentence is exactly: the pinned local artifact set is admitted as the canonical development and validation pair; equality to the experimental presentation edition remains unconfirmed. It must not call the pair the experimental edition, imply raw-video redistribution, or start C1.

No docs edit or reservation now. At reopening, re-read the landed six-path intake and the then-current dirty roadmap, preflight exact paths, and request a two-path-or-smaller scope. The status repair depends on B0R landing; it does not repair G0 or substitute for P1R.
